subject: Mutual plan + capacity lockdown: Orchid Labs Dedicated/Private sizing & lead times
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: María Ortega <maria.ortega@orchidlabs.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan + capacity lockdown: Orchid Labs Dedicated/Private sizing & lead times

Hi María —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, I pulled together an initial mutual action plan (attached) that focuses only on the capacity commitment and onboarding timeline steps we need to close by mid-August. High-level asks from your side:

- Confirm target steady-state concurrency (rps) and 95th percentile per-request token length so we can size KV cache needs.
- Agree on whether Private (VPC) deployment is required at day 1 or if a Dedicated-hosted pool is acceptable for the first 90 days.
- Sign off on acceptance criteria (simple perf SLA + smoke tests) so we can start procurement once you confirm the tranche.

Notes on lead times we baked in:
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool): typical procurement + capacity placement = 10–14 weeks from signed commitment for H100s, 6–9 weeks if A100s are acceptable.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): 12–18 weeks including customer network preparation and KMS integration; plan for an additional 2–3 weeks for air-gapped validations if required.

Pool sizing options we propose in the sheet:
A) Baseline: 8 x H100 (sustained inference) — targets 180k tokens/min aggregate; 10% buffer.
B) Hybrid: 4 x H100 + 16 x A100s (mixed workload) — saves ~18% unit cost, slightly higher latency tail.
C) Conservative: 12 x A100s (cost-first runway) — best if you expect bursty traffic but lower overall commitment.

If you can confirm the expected concurrency and whether Private is required, we’ll lock the MAP and push it through Deal Desk for a procurement schedule and pre-authorization for the tranche.

Attached: orchid_map_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP, milestones), orchid_procurement_estimate.pdf (lead time & pricing), acceptance_criteria.md (test checklist)

Best,
Michael
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: María Ortega <maria.ortega@orchidlabs.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual plan + capacity lockdown: Orchid Labs Dedicated/Private sizing & lead times

Hi Michael —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifications from our side before we lock anything down:

- Steady-state: we expect ~60 concurrent sessions at peak with an average request ~1.8k tokens and spikes to ~4k tokens for long-context experiments. Peak window is US business hours.
- Privacy/SOC2: we need Private (VPC) by go-live due to PHI-like telemetry. Can the initial 90-day period still run on Dedicated while we finish network approvals if we commit now?
- Acceptance: the acceptance_criteria looks reasonable but add a gating item for audit/log retention visibility (we need 90-days raw request logs).

We attached a short workbook (orchid_resource_estimate.xlsx) with traffic pattern samples. If Dedicated can be the temporary runway while we finish VPC, we want to compress the lead time as much as possible. What lead-time compression levers do you have (pre-authorization, early deposit, alternative regions)?

Thanks — will loop procurement once you confirm the routing approach (Dedicated-first vs Private-day-one).

— María
Director, Platform Ops
Orchid Labs

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: María Ortega <maria.ortega@orchidlabs.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual plan + capacity lockdown: Orchid Labs Dedicated/Private sizing & lead times

María —

Appreciate the details and the sample workbook. Short answers: yes — Dedicated-first is a supported pattern and is our recommended path to meet your mid-August target while Private/VPC is completed in parallel. Specific levers to shorten lead time:

1) Pre-authorization & early deposit: we can reserve the tranche in 48–72 hours with a refundable deposit and start procurement paperwork; this shifts the 10–14 week window toward the shorter end.
2) Region flexibility: if you can accept a US-west placement vs US-east we often find capacity comes online 2–3 weeks earlier.
3) Model/quantization flexibility: agreeing to an int8-quantized variant for early production reduces required H100 count by ~20% and shortens procurement SKU constraints.

Given your traffic profile (60 concurrent, 4k token spikes), our recommended MAP path:
- Phase 0 (Immediate): Lock Dedicated baseline — 6 x H100 equivalent (via hybrid config) for runway; acceptance smoke tests run in 7 business days after provision.
- Phase 1 (Parallel): Network & KMS prep for Private — target 10–12 weeks parallel track; we’ll provide a pre-populated network checklist.
- Phase 2 (Cutover): Day-90 cutover to Private if gating items pass; otherwise extend Dedicated with buffer tranche.

I’ve updated the MAP draft to include the phased plan and a tentative milestone calendar — see orchid_map_draft_v1.xlsx (tab: PhasePlan). If you confirm Dedicated runway and agree to a deposit, I’ll coordinate Deal Desk and commit the tranche.

Best,
Michael

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Mutual plan + capacity lockdown: Orchid Labs Dedicated/Private sizing & lead times

Team —

Forwarding María's note and my reply. Key asks: Dedicated runway (6 x H100 equivalent) with refundable deposit, compressed delivery (US-west preferred), and a Private/VPC cutover in ~10–12 weeks. Procurement will expect a deposit and an SLA exception for audit log retention (90 days) — need Product/Infra to confirm feasibility and cost.

Monica: can you confirm the commercial terms we can offer on a 6–9 month reserved tranche and the refundable deposit structure?
Karthik: can you validate the Private onboarding checklist timelines and flag any gating infra work that would add time?

If we can pre-authorize the tranche this week, I’ll send a short contract addendum and route to Deal Desk.

— Michael

From: María Ortega <maria.ortega@orchidlabs.ai>

Cc: Orchid Labs Procurement <procurement@orchidlabs.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan + capacity lockdown: Orchid Labs Dedicated/Private sizing & lead times

Michael —

Confirmed on our side: procurement is prepared to move with a refundable deposit and is willing to accept US-west placement. We will sign a 9-month tranche with the Dedicated runway, and will start the VPC approvals immediately. Please send the contract addendum and the pre-populated network checklist — procurement will need the exact KMS/certificate requirements to route internally.

Acceptance gating: we will hold final go/no-go for cutover on the Private side to the 90-day smoke test report and visibility into the requested audit logs for the test window.

Once you send the addendum we’ll aim to return counters within 48 hours. Thanks — excited to get this moving.

— María
Director, Platform Ops
Orchid Labs
